defects.what: The river creature is a big-eyed green frog-lizard with no shell and no water dish, so it does not read as the turtle-shelled kappa with the dish on its head from the shot before.
The boat photo sticks out past the phone body like a loose card instead of sitting inside the screen.
defects.where: phone in Indio's hand, lower left

defects.what: The printed speech Tubal reads is covered in dense letter-like gibberish that is plain to see when paused.
Rico wears a neon-yellow shirt and has a different, older stubbled face, while the next-door shot k58 shows him young and clean-shaven in a white shirt.
Usman has two tall upright ears and no folded ear, and his white chest patch is reduced to a small bib under the kerchief.
Usman is drawn as a rottweiler-type dog with tan legs and tan muzzle and both ears folded, not the plain black street dog with one folded ear.
The tan folder on the notary's desk carries small lines of letter-like scribbles.
Both of Usman's ears are folded down; the series dog has only one folded ear.
Indio wears a black necktie; his look in this episode is a dark suit with no tie.
Indio wears a dark tie in the far background.
The budget sheet under the medallion has small letter-like scribbles in its table.
The younger man whose shoulder Gorio pats has short spiky black hair with no grey topknot, so he does not read as Indio.
Gorio's barong turns into a colourful floral print, while k34-k36 show it cream with gold embroidery.
Both of Usman's ears hang folded; the series dog has only one folded ear.
The worker's hand on the stake is a smooth lump where the fingers cannot be counted.
The kappa is a plain real-looking turtle on the rock, without the dish or upright body of k47.
defects.where: small turtle on rock, centre left

defects.what: The engineer in the light-blue helmet has a smeared face with garbled glasses and mouth.
Indio wears a black necktie, unlike his no-tie look.
Totoy wears a green shirt here but a tan work shirt in k52 and k54.
Tubal's face, hair and tie change between k56 and k57 (smooth smiling face, purple tie vs heavy scowling face, black tie), so he reads as a different man.
Rico's hand behind the tripod is a shapeless lump with a stray purple shape where the fingers should be.
defects.where: hand behind tripod legs, lower left

defects.what: The red presidential chair has two stacked backrests, one behind the other.
The museum shelf is a glossy 3D-render look, unlike the flat anime drawing of the rest of the episode.
The two museum label cards carry small letter-like scribbles.
The 'kappa' figurine is a black-and-white panda- or penguin-like doll with no shell, no dish and not green, so it does not read as the kappa of k47.
Usman's two eyes are different colours, one pale grey and one amber.
The bird circling above is a plain red-headed hawk with brown wings, not the rooster-bodied sarimanok with the long multicoloured tail from k50.

refuted.what: Indio wears a tie here, unlike his no-tie look elsewhere.
refuted.why: At 3x Indio's collar is open with no tie; only Gorio wears a thin black cord, so Indio is on model.
